استجهلن (form X)
# اِسْتَجْهَلْنَ (istajhalna) /is.tad͡ʒ.hal.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَجْهَلَ (istajhala)
# اُسْتُجْهِلْنَ (ustujhilna) /us.tud͡ʒ.hil.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَجْهَلَ (istajhala)
# اِسْتَجْهِلْنَ (istajhilna) /is.tad͡ʒ.hil.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَجْهَلَ (istajhala)
